model_system: Floquet-driven Hubbard-Kanamori model for spin-orbit-coupled d^2 Mott insulators with edge-sharing octahedra (effective Eg non-Kramers doublet / multipolar pseudospin model on a honeycomb lattice)

key_params.derivation: time-dependent Floquet Schrieffer-Wolff expansion of driven Hubbard-Kanamori model
key_params.numerics: exact diagonalization for phase diagram; representative DMRG textures
key_params.equilibrium_reference: only AFO phase remains without CPL

headline_claim: Circularly polarized light induces an effective static field linearly coupled to the magnetic octupole (octupolar inverse Faraday effect) and a bond-dependent anisotropic exchange, yielding a driven phase diagram with AFO, FO, PPFQ, IO, and multipolar-liquid regimes absent in equilibrium.
replication_difficulty: high - requires reproducing a Floquet Schrieffer-Wolff derivation and many-body ED/DMRG phase identification, while the key quantitative couplings are not given in the provided excerpt.
